name: Gasthof Ranalt
beschreibung: The Gasthof Ranalt is located in the Ranalt district at the end of the Stubaital in Neustift. The area is surrounded by the high mountain landscape of the Stubaier Alpen. The inn offers a traditional dining room with regional cuisine. The rooms are furnished in Tiroler style and equipped with practical amenities. Guests use the house as a starting point for hikes to the surrounding alpine huts. In winter, a ski bus provides the connection to the Stubaier Gletscher ski area. The valley location is characterized by peace and seclusion. An inn with a long tradition in the valley.
